const arrayValue = [1].values().next().value;
console.log(arrayValue.toFixed());
const setValue = new Set([1]).values().next().value;
const invalidString: string = setValue;
const mapValue = new Map([["a", 1]]).values().next().value;
console.log(mapValue.toFixed());
const regexValue = "a".matchAll(/a/g).next().value;
console.log(regexValue.length);
function street<C extends string>(colors: C[], defaultColor?: NoInfer<C>) {}
street(["red", "green"], "blue");
function only<T>(value: NoInfer<T>): T {return value;}
const n: number = only(1);
function nested<T>(value: T, other: NoInfer<T[]>): T {return value;}
nested(1, ["wrong"]);
function optional<T>(value: T, other: NoInfer<T | undefined>): T {return value;}
optional(1, "wrong");
